title: Semester and Playlist
author: Odile Vane
blurb: Ada Galloway, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
